title: Ender Node
description: Sculk + The End = weird teleportation devices
body:
# Ender Node
Ever wondered what those portal-like structures in ancient cities were? Well this mod doesn't do anything about that! With the focus on teleportation in the end, and the mysterious power of the sculk, one can craft tools to quickly traverse the world by hopping between dimensions.

## Items
### Warp Node
The Warp Node teleports entities on top of it to another warp node up to 100 blocks in front of it's eye. It only works in the end.
![Warp Node Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a67087e0790650d71800836b027f77498aa5f0a4.png)

### Basic Teleportation Node
The Basic Teleportation Node teleports all nearby entities to another node in a different dimension. The nodes must be within 15 blocks cross-dimensionally, and must be linked using a Dimensional Linker.
![Basic Node Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2762faf1f5055aa84bf593dce4a5d15425714e47.png)

### Dimensional Linker
The Dimensional Linker is used to link two basic teleportation nodes together. Be careful, because if the nodes are in the same dimension, one will explode.
![Dimensional Linker Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b450f1d15028f27c3b8956de1ea561b0a1a377ae.png)

### Dimensional Bore
The Dimensional Bore allows the user to switch between the overworld and the end. Useful for setting up basic teleportation nodes, but has a high risk of causing said user to fall into the void.
![Dimensional Bore Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ccb5799a8cf0a7fa2ca9d9c0a8feb49ffaffe6b1.png)

<details>
<summary>Why does this mod exist?</summary>
  I wanted to experiment with making pixel art and block models/animations, and I decided to learn by making a mod!
  Yes, I made it in MCreator as learning Java was not the purpose of this project.
</details>
